title: Staggered windowed attention scheduler with KV warm-lanes and subtile fusion
author: Ravi Gupta
description: Motivation: reduce p50/p95 latency variability for short sequences while improving throughput for mixed-length workloads. We observed tail spikes when the continuous-batcher and the KV cache warmed up simultaneously for traffic with high small-request ratio. This PR introduces a staggered windowed attention scheduler that coordinates small 'subtile' kernel invocations with explicit KV warm-lanes, plus a lightweight subtile fusion pass that reduces kernel-launch overhead on short contexts. Summary of changes: 1) scheduler: add runtime/scheduler/staggered_scheduler.cpp (staggered policy that separates warm-lane traffic from cold misses, assigns micro-tiles to dedicated executors, and prioritizes short-seq hotpaths) 2) kernels: add runtime/attn/subtile_kernel.cu and runtime/attn/subtile_fuse_pass.cc (subtile is a small-window Flash-inspired kernel optimized for seq_len <= 64; fusion pass folds rotary/unapply steps to remove an extra transpose) 3) kv: add runtime/kv/warm_lane.cpp and warm_lane.h (a tiny lane allocator that prefetches KV pages for hot prefixes and exposes a warm token to the scheduler) 4) orchestration: hooks in runtime/orchestrator/continuous_batcher.cpp to surface warm-lane hints and schedule micro-batches without flushing the KV cache 5) tests/bench/windowed_prefetch_bench.py and tests/unit/test_warm_lane.py 6) docs/perf/attn-windowed-warmlanes.md. Key design details: - Staggered policy keeps a short-latency lane and a warm-lane pool; the short lane uses the subtile kernel and avoids preemption by large-batch coalescing. - Warm-lanes maintain a small LRU of KV page IDs and drive async prefetches; scheduler uses a 3-level priority score (latency-sensitivity, cache-affinity, batchable). - Subtile kernel implements a fused rotary application + QK partial reduction, avoiding an intermediate transpose for small windows; uses warp-level accumulators and avoids shared-memory for >32 heads to minimize bank conflicts. - Continuous batching changes: the batcher now exposes 'microbatch affinity' to indicate compatibility with subtile execution, enabling continuous flushless batching for sequences composed predominantly of short tokens. Performance: - Internal bench (g4dn-like node) on mixed chat workload (60% seq<=32, 30% seq 64-128, 10% >256): p50 latency improved 9.4%, p95 improved 12.1%, overall throughput improved 18% at 95% utilization. - Cold-start KV tail (first request after model swap) reduced from median 120ms extra to 72ms extra for hot prefixes (40% reduction). - Microbench of subtile kernel vs generic kernel for seq=32 shows 2.3x reduction in kernel launch overhead and 1.6x token/sec improvement. Backwards compatibility: fallback to existing flash/attn path when subtile guard conditions fail (seq>64 or incompatible head counts). Flags: runtime.feature.subtile=true (off by default for safety) and runtime.feature.kv_warmlane=true. Rollout plan: staged on Dedicated canary pools then Hosted: start with 10% traffic, monitor p50/p95 and KV hit ratio; if regressions occur auto-disable features. Commits: ["Add staggered scheduler and policy (staggered_scheduler.cpp)", "Implement subtile attention kernel (subtile_kernel.cu)", "Subtile fusion pass and build flags (subtile_fuse_pass.cc)", "KV warm-lane allocator and async prefetch (warm_lane.cpp)", "Batcher hooks and affinity propagation (continuous_batcher.cpp)", "Bench and unit tests", "Docs and perf notes"]
CI: initial CI run showed one flaky unit test (tests/unit/test_warm_lane.py::test_lane_eviction) failing under ASAN on ubuntu-latest; developer reproduced locally, fixed memory race by adding a tiny lock in warm_lane.h, re-ran CI; all checks passed.
Security/infra: change adds two new small surface areas (warm-lane async prefetch queues) - validated no direct network calls, prefetches constrained to model-local storage and bound to process credentials.
Observability: added metrics: attn.subtile.invocations, kv.warm_lane.prefetches, scheduler.microbatch.affinity_ratio; dashboards updated in docs.
Release notes: Introduce staggered windowed attention scheduler and subtile kernel for short-context acceleration
KV warm-lanes reduce cold-start tail for hot prefixes
Feature flags control rollout and safety
